api_endpoint.description: API Endpoint for the Cloudpilotai API.

api_key.description: API key for the Cloudpilotai API.

api_key_profile.description: API key profile for the Cloudpilotai API.

account_id.description: AWS account ID where the cluster is deployed (computed)

agent_version.description: Version of the CloudPilot AI agent currently installed on the cluster (computed).

role_arn.description: IAM role ARN to assume before CloudPilot performs AWS CLI, kubectl, or helm operations.

session_name.description: Optional STS session name used when assuming the role. Defaults to cloudpilotai-terraform when omitted.

aws_assume_role.description: Optional IAM role to assume for CloudPilot AWS CLI and kubeconfig operations. Source credentials still come from aws_profile or the ambient AWS credential chain.

aws_profile.description: AWS CLI named profile to use as the source credential for AWS operations. If empty, the default AWS credential chain is used.

cluster_id.description: Unique identifier of the EKS cluster. Optional override for existing clusters when the caller already knows the server-side cluster ID.

cluster_name.description: Name of the EKS cluster to be managed

discount.description: Cluster-level discount ratio used by cost calculations.

enable_disk_monitor.description: Enable disk monitor for this cluster.

enable_node_repair.description: Enable CloudPilot AI node repair for this cluster.

post_run_command.description: Command run after maintenance or repair actions.

pre_run_command.description: Command run before maintenance or repair actions.

cluster_setting.description: Optional cluster-level setting fields exposed by /api/v1/clusters/{cluster_id}/setting.

custom_node_role.description: Custom IAM role name for EC2 instances. When set, this role will be added to the CloudPilot controller's PassNodeIAMRole policy during installation, allowing the controller to pass this role to EC2 instances.

disable_workload_uploading.description: Disable automatic uploading of workload information to CloudPilot AI

enable_rebalance.description: Enable automatic workload rebalancing across node pools. Ignores `only_install_agent` if set to true.

enable_upgrade.description: Enable upgrading CloudPilot AI components through the cluster upgrade script. The provider checks whether the cluster needs upgrade first, and only runs the upgrade when required.

kubeconfig.description: Kubernetes configuration file path for accessing the EKS cluster. If not set, the provider generates a kubeconfig that includes the required exec auth for aws_profile and aws_assume_role.

need_upgrade.description: Whether the CloudPilot service currently reports that this cluster needs an upgrade (computed).

ami_alias.description: EKS optimized AMI alias, for example 'al2023@latest'. Maps to spec.amiSelectorTerms alias.

ebs.description: EBS settings for this block device.

root_volume.description: Whether this mapping is the kubelet root volume.

block_device_mappings.description: Full EC2 blockDeviceMappings list. Do not combine with system_disk_size_gib on the same NodeClass.

enable_image_accelerator.description: Enable image accelerator (for example Spegel) for this nodeclass.

extra_cpu_allocation_mcore.description: Each provisioned node will have extra CPU allocation, used only for burstable pods.

extra_memory_allocation_mib.description: Each provisioned node will have extra Memory allocation, used only for burstable pods.

instance_tags.description: Each provisioned EC2 instance will have the configured tags as key-value pairs. If omitted, CloudPilot keeps its default managed instance tag configuration.

role.description: IAM role name for the EC2 instances launched by this NodeClass. Defaults to `CloudPilotNodeRole-{cluster_name}` if not set.

id.description: EC2 security group ID (for example `sg-0123456789abcdef0`). Mutually exclusive with `tags` and `name`.

name.description: Security group name (the EC2 name field, not the name tag). Mutually exclusive with `tags` and `id`.

tags.description: Tag key/value map to select security groups (AND within this block). Mutually exclusive with `id` and `name`.

security_group_selector_terms.description: Security group selector terms (ORed). Each block sets exactly one of non-empty `tags`, `id`, or `name`. If omitted, defaults to one tag selector `{"cluster.cloudpilot.ai/{cluster_name}": "true"}`.

id.description: EC2 subnet ID (for example `subnet-0123456789abcdef0`). Mutually exclusive with `tags`.

tags.description: Tag key/value map to select subnets (AND within this block). Mutually exclusive with `id`.

subnet_selector_terms.description: Subnet selector terms (ORed). Each block uses non-empty `tags` or `id` (mutually exclusive). If omitted, defaults to one tag selector `{"cluster.cloudpilot.ai/{cluster_name}": "true"}`.

system_disk_size_gib.description: Each provisioned node's system storage size. Do not combine with block_device_mappings on the same NodeClass.

user_data.description: NodeClass userData passed to Karpenter EC2NodeClass spec.userData.

nodeclasses.description: NodeClasses configuration (no change if not set)

capacity_type.description: The provisioned node's capacity type, on-demand or spot.

enable_gpu.description: Enable GPU instances in this nodepool.

enable_image_accelerator.description: Enable image accelerator (for example Spegel) in this nodepool.

instance_arch.description: The target instance architecture, if the instance family is configured, this field will be ignored.

instance_cpu_max.description: Maximum CPU cores per node. Used to filter instance types during node provisioning. Set to 0 for unlimited.

instance_cpu_min.description: Minimum CPU cores per node. Used to filter instance types during node provisioning. Set to 0 for unlimited.

instance_family.description: The target instance family, like t3, m5 and so on, split by comma.

instance_memory_max.description: Maximum memory in MiB per node. Used to filter instance types during node provisioning. Set to 0 for unlimited.

instance_memory_min.description: Minimum memory in MiB per node. Used to filter instance types during node provisioning. Set to 0 for unlimited.

labels.description: Labels applied to provisioned nodes through spec.template.metadata.labels.

node_disruption_delay.description: Specify the duration (e.g., 10s, 10m, or 10h) that the controller waits before terminating underutilized nodes.

node_disruption_limit.description: This specifies the maximum number of nodes that can be terminated at once, either as a fixed number (e.g., 2) or a percentage (e.g., 10%).

nodeclass.description: Select the nodeclass to use for this nodepool.

provision_priority.description: The priority level of this nodepool. A larger number means a higher priority.

effect.description: Taint effect: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule, or NoExecute.

taints.description: Taints applied to provisioned nodes through spec.template.spec.taints.

zone.description: Each provisioned node will located in the configured zone, formatted as us-west-1a,us-west-1b.

nodepool_templates.description: NodePools configuration (no change if not set)

effect.description: Taint effect: NoSchedule, PreferNoSchedule, or NoExecute.

zone.description: Each provisioned node will located in the configured zone, formatted as us-west-1a,us-west-1b.

nodepools.description: NodePools configuration (no change if not set)

onboard_manifest_version.description: Latest CloudPilot onboard manifest version reported by the service (computed).

only_install_agent.description: Only install the CloudPilot AI agent without additional configuration

region.description: AWS region where the EKS cluster is located

restore_node_number.description: Number of nodes to provision from the original node group when destroying the CloudPilot AI resource. Set to 0 (the default) to leave the cluster in its current optimized state without restoring original nodes. Set to a positive integer to restore that many nodes before uninstalling. Only effective when `skip_restore` is false.

skip_restore.description: When set to true, skip the node restore step during resource destruction. The cluster will be uninstalled without restoring original nodes first. Takes precedence over `restore_node_number`.

workload_templates.description: Workload templates configuration (no change if not set)

workloads.description: Workloads configuration (no change if not set)

disable_runtime_optimization.description: Disable runtime-based optimization for workloads matched by this AutoscalingPolicy.

drift_threshold_cpu.description: CPU drift threshold as a quantity or percent (e.g. '10%').

drift_threshold_memory.description: Memory drift threshold as a quantity or percent (e.g. '10%').

in_place_fallback_default_policy.description: Default fallback policy when in-place update fails: 'recreate' or 'hold'.

in_place_fallback_reason_policies.description: Fallback policy overrides keyed by in-place failure reason.

multiplier.description: Multiplier for limit relative to request (e.g. '2.0').

on_policy_removal.description: Behavior when the policy is removed: 'off', 'recreate', or 'inplace'.

priority.description: Priority level when multiple policies match the same workload. Higher values take precedence.

recommendation_policy_name.description: Name of the RecommendationPolicy to use.

startup_boost_enabled.description: Enable startup resource boost for newly created pods.

startup_boost_min_boost_duration.description: Minimum duration for the startup boost (e.g. '5m').

startup_boost_min_ready_duration.description: Minimum ready duration before removing the boost (e.g. '3m').

values.description: Selector values used by the operator.

match_labels.description: Label key/value pairs that selected workloads must match.

label_selector.description: Kubernetes label selector for matching workloads.

name.description: Workload name. Leave empty to match all workloads of this kind.

namespace.description: Namespace. Leave empty to match all namespaces.

update_schedules.description: Update schedule items controlling when and how updates are applied.

autoscaling_policies.description: List of AutoscalingPolicy resources to manage.

cluster_id.description: The CloudPilot AI cluster ID to deploy Workload Autoscaler on.

disable_proactive_update.description: Filter by whether proactive update is disabled on the workload.

namespaces.description: Namespaces to filter workloads. Leave empty to match all namespaces.

optimized.description: Filter by whether the workload is optimized.

workload_kinds.description: Workload kinds to filter (e.g. 'Deployment', 'StatefulSet'). Leave empty to match all kinds.

disable_proactive.description: List of workload filters to disable proactive optimization. Each entry selects workloads by the specified filters and disables proactive update for them.

enable_initial_optimization_data_window_.description: Require the initial optimization data window before enabling mutation and update paths for new workloads.

enable_new_workloads_proactive_update.description: Enable proactive update automatically for new workloads once recommendations are ready.

enable_node_agent.description: Whether to enable the Node Agent DaemonSet for per-node metrics collection.

enable_preempted_pod_gc.description: Enable garbage collection for preempted pods.

disable_proactive_update.description: Filter by whether proactive update is disabled on the workload.

namespaces.description: Namespaces to filter workloads. Leave empty to match all namespaces.

optimized.description: Filter by whether the workload is optimized.

workload_kinds.description: Workload kinds to filter (e.g. 'Deployment', 'StatefulSet'). Leave empty to match all kinds.

enable_proactive.description: List of workload filters to enable proactive optimization. Each entry selects workloads by the specified filters and enables proactive update for them.

kubeconfig.description: Path to the kubeconfig file for the target Kubernetes cluster. Required for create/update/delete operations, but not needed for import. The kubeconfig must already be able to authenticate to the target cluster. For EKS, using cloudpilotai_eks_cluster.this.kubeconfig satisfies this requirement.

limiter_burst.description: Workload Autoscaler rate-limit burst. Server requires a positive value.

limiter_quota_per_window.description: Workload Autoscaler rate-limit quota per limiter window. Server requires a positive value.

limiter_window_seconds.description: Workload Autoscaler limiter window in seconds. Server requires a positive value.

preempted_pod_gc_ttl.description: TTL for preempted pod garbage collection, for example '30m'.

buffer_cpu.description: CPU buffer as a quantity or percent (e.g. '10%' or '100m').

buffer_memory.description: Memory buffer as a quantity or percent (e.g. '10%' or '128Mi').

history_window_cpu.description: Duration of the CPU history window (e.g. '168h').

history_window_memory.description: Duration of the Memory history window (e.g. '168h').

jvm_heap_buffer.description: JVM heap buffer for HeapXmx, for example '25%' or '300Mi'.

jvm_heap_used_percentile.description: JVM heap-used percentile, valid server range is 20 to 100.

jvm_min_heap_xms_ratio_of_memory.description: Minimum ratio of HeapXms to JVM memory recommendation, for example '0.25'.

jvm_recent_non_heap_window.description: Recent non-heap protection window, for example '2h'.

percentile_cpu.description: Target CPU percentile (50-100) when strategy_type is 'percentile'.

percentile_memory.description: Target Memory percentile (50-100) when strategy_type is 'percentile'.

strategy_type.description: Recommendation strategy type. Currently only 'percentile' is supported.

recommendation_policies.description: List of RecommendationPolicy resources to manage.

storage_class.description: StorageClass name for VictoriaMetrics persistent volume. If empty, the cluster default StorageClass is used.

account_id.description: AWS account ID. If not provided, it will be detected from the current AWS CLI credentials.

agent_version.description: Version of the CloudPilot AI agent installed on the cluster.

cluster_id.description: CloudPilot AI cluster identifier. When provided, this override is used directly and the data source does not derive the default ID from cluster_name, region, and account_id.

need_upgrade.description: Whether CloudPilot currently reports that this cluster needs an upgrade.

onboard_manifest_version.description: Latest CloudPilot onboard manifest version reported by the service.

rebalance_enable.description: Whether rebalancing is enabled for this cluster.

region.description: AWS region where the EKS cluster is located.

status.description: Current status of the cluster: 'online', 'offline', or 'demo'.

block.description: Retrieves information about an existing EKS cluster registered with CloudPilot AI.

enabled.description: Whether the Workload Autoscaler is enabled on this cluster.

installed.description: Whether the Workload Autoscaler is installed on this cluster.

block.description: Retrieves the Workload Autoscaler configuration for a given cluster.
